title: Article front matter
description: YAML front matter of articles/*/*.md. depends_on + written_at let the generator flag cards added after the article was written (Q14). kind 'math' marks the formula-explanation series (articles/math/), whose primer may have no tags.

tags.description: Tags this article covers. A new card sharing any of these tags and not in depends_on counts as 'not yet reflected'.

depends_on.description: Paper/experiment card IDs the prose was written from.
